description.zh: 先看单件构图与作者，再核对订阅和具体许可。 Envato Elements 的插画与数字绘图素材栏目，支持按类别和应用筛选、分页浏览及单件作品预览。本次进入德语页面，查看了 Creattie 的心脏健康分析插画；下载入口要求订阅，完整订阅价格与适用许可尚未核完，没有取得付费文件。
description.en: The illustration and digital drawing section of Envato Elements, with category and application filters, paginated browsing, and individual previews. This visit used the German pages and viewed a heart-health analysis illustration by Creattie. Downloading requires a subscription; complete pricing and applicable license terms remain unverified, and no paid file has been obtained.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Envato Elements · Illustrations (https://elements.envato.com/de/graphics/illustrations).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 先看单件构图与作者，再核对订阅和具体许可。

Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
